dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Lantern Rite was simply amazing! I'm not sure I'll be able to sleep tonight!

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Oh, that? Yeah, interesting story.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: It was invented by a guy from Fontaine. His name is Ildesson.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: He's always tinkering away at some mechanism or another. He's even asked The Steambird to write about his inventions on more than one occasion.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: I believe I have a direct quote from him about this particular one. Ah yes, here it is.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: The device is powered entirely by mechanical components without the need for any additional energy source...

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Basically, it's a manually operated cranking device. How high it can fly entirely depends on how much force you can exert...

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Combining this invention with a kite... What a great idea, right!

choices.text: About the interview and working together with Gaming's father...

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: My conversation with Mr. Yip went really well. I've already sent the first draft of my article back to The Steambird.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: It's a piece that contains all the pertinent information while also telling a story. I'm quite proud of it.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Oh, that reminds me, I should thank everyone who made this possible for me！Especially that spirited lady with those peculiar turns of phrase... Miss Xianyun was her name, right?

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: It was all thanks to your connections and creativity. I would have never thought I'd be able to bring such a special gift back to Fontaine with me.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: This was my first time experiencing a foreign holiday in person. It was... so exciting!

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: The festive atmosphere, the contagious holiday spirit, the profound, storied cultural traditions steeped in symbolism...

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Ah, I almost forgot! Keqing even gave me a kite with a poem on it that she wrote herself!

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: It goes, "Dreams are like paper kites, with them do our hopes take flight, sailing high above the clouds, they yearn for something more profound, yet try we may and try we might, a deeper truth waits in plain sight, though we hang our hopes in skies abound, many joys lie on the ground."

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: I want to include this poem in my special feature on Lantern Rite. I'm sure a lot of people will love it!

choices.text: About the interview and working together with Gaming's father...

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Yep! And Happy Lantern Rite to you!

choices.text: About the interview and working together with Gaming's father...

dialogues.speaker: Jiehu
dialogues.text: Given your present countenance, one presumes you are missing some old friends again?

dialogues.speaker: Houzhang
dialogues.text: One cannot help but be reminded of them...

dialogues.speaker: Jiehu
dialogues.text: Pray, speak. Unburden yourself of these sentiments.

dialogues.speaker: Houzhang
dialogues.text: One simply wishes Menogias were alive to witness such peace alongside us.

dialogues.speaker: Houzhang
dialogues.text: He was so skilled in matters of craftsmanship. Kite-making would scarcely prove to be a test of his capabilities. Were he yet amongst the living, he could have opened a kite stall. One is certain it would have been an establishment rich not only in profit but also esteem.

dialogues.speaker: Houzhang
dialogues.text: And if, as in the past, he were unable to involve himself in matters of the mortal realm, we could sell the kites in his stead. When we finished, we could bring him back wine and partake in drink and good company...

dialogues.speaker: Jiehu
dialogues.text: Moon Carver. Those are now but fond moments in our memories.

dialogues.speaker: Houzhang
dialogues.text: ...Indeed. The dead are gone, so, as the representatives of the living...

dialogues.speaker: Houzhang
dialogues.text: Let us take in the sights for a bit longer, if just for his sake.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: I don't get it...

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Is something wrong, Shenhe? Tell me. Perhaps I can help.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: The color black doesn't get dirty easily, so I thought this outfit would be acceptable to wear to work. But Xiangling told me it was inappropriate.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: But inappropriate... how?

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: ...She probably just meant the outfit isn't suitable for that particular environment and occasion.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: But for a festival gathering with friends, a nighttime stroll, or an important banquet... your outfit is more than appropriate, Shenhe.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: So you're saying it's only something I should wear in front of important people.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Hm... I suppose that's another way to think of it.

dialogues.speaker: Yip Tak
dialogues.text: So you're still a big fan of Winter Melon Cake then?

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Eh? Oh, I guess you heard everything Paimon was saying, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Yip Tak
dialogues.text: Hehe... Of course. She was talking about you. As your father, how could I not listen?

dialogues.speaker: Yip Tak
dialogues.text: Remember back when you were a kid and you would sit on my shoulders to watch the Wushou dance? On our way back home, you would beg me to buy you some Winter Melon Cake.

dialogues.speaker: Yip Tak
dialogues.text: We would only buy two at a time, but before long, we'd tried the Winter Melon Cake from every vendor that street had to offer.

dialogues.speaker: Yip Tak
dialogues.text: There was also that one time you used your pocket money to treat me! Do you still remember?

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Yeah... I remember.

dialogues.speaker: Yip Tak
dialogues.text: That was the best Winter Melon Cake I ever had...

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Let's go back sometime. The shop's still there, and I remember the way. My treat, just like before.

dialogues.speaker: Yip Tak
dialogues.text: ...Are you sure?

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Absolutely!

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: Our kite is so high up.

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: Thank you for inviting me, Yaoyao. I am having... a lot of fun.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: I'm glad!

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: If you want, we can go fly kites some other time too. The fun doesn't have to end today!

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: Really?

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: How about we do it during the day next time? That way, we can see the design better! When it flies super high up, it will look exactly like a real finch.

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: Okay.

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: Can I... take this kite to bed with me?

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Hehe, but of course!

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: One may have won the kite-flying competition, Yuheng, but this prize should truly be reserved for another.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: You need not be so humble, Honored Adeptus. Among all the kites, yours was quite literally a cut above the rest. Please accept this prize. You deserve it.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Besides, I'm quite certain we owe a fair share of the success of this year's Lantern Rite to you...

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: ...Hm, if you insist, then one can hardly continue to refuse. However, there is another matter with which one would ask your assistance.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Of course.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: One would be much obliged if you could distribute this case of Sunglo Tea among the Millelith on duty. The security of the festivities rests entirely on their shoulders, after all. One presumes they could always benefit from something to invigorate their spirits.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: (Cloud Retainer is so thoughtful and attentive to others' needs! I would expect nothing less of an esteemed adeptus such as herself.)

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Understood. I'll get on that right away.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: (Phew... a fortuitous result indeed. One's tea surplus has hitherto resolved itself.)

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's just as I thought... You stopped short of stepping into the city again.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Being in the city isn't the only way for me to appreciate the lights and beauty of Lantern Rite. Look... Liyue Harbor lies just beyond this mountain.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: As long as I stand at this vantage point, I may freely behold the sight of all the kites slowly ascending into the sky.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: ...For me, that is enough.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Alright.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: I invited you here because there is something I would like to do.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: ...I want to release a Xiao Lantern, and... I'd like you to be there for it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Did you make it yourself?

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Yes.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: I apologize for its crude appearance... I have little skill in that regard.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No, no! It's amazing.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: ...You are very kind, as usual.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Alright. It's time.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (As the Xiao Lantern slowly disappears into the tranquil night sky, Xiao's expression softens.)

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: ...Thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Hi, I'm Linlang. I run an antiques shop called Xigu Antiques... How may I help you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About kites...

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: They carry peoples' thoughts into the skies. Don't you think that's quite similar to how Xiao Lanterns work?

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: This year's theme is kites, which connects with the idea of those lanterns in interesting ways.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: I wonder if there're any legends that also link the two... Should there be any link to ancient relics, that would make for a most captivating story.

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: Hello there, friend. Have you decided on the sort of kites you'd like to make?

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: Ah, sorry, I didn't mean to pry. I just wanted to perhaps use your work as reference material.

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: I've been waiting for this holiday for so long, but now that it's here, I can't figure out which patterns I like...

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: I mean, there's no way I'll be sewing expired documents into a kite, surely?

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: I'm kidding. It's fine even if I don't have my own kite, really. It'll still be interesting watching others fly theirs.

dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: When is Daddy coming back? Is it too late to write him and ask for a Suanni kite?

dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: I saw one, a glowing one, while playing by myself!

dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: Hmm... I wonder if Daddy could buy me one?

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: Heh, doubtless, the city is more festive.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: The heroes we commemorate during Lantern Rite are actually adepti who lived in Liyue in the distant past.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: Do you know which adeptus the Mingxiao Lantern commemorates this year?

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: I asked around for information, and a gentleman who looked very knowledgeable told me that the adeptus' name is Menogias, also known as General Kapisas.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: I've heard that although he was most famous for being a deadly yaksha warrior, he was also well-versed in clothing design and tailoring.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: An adeptus of artistry, sounds like! I'm sure he will bless us with novelty!

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: Do you ever think that there might be some kites that can no longer be retrieved after being sent up into the sky?

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: I guess so? Even if you could control the line, the wind might decline your commands all the same.

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: Speaking of that, should we go buy one? I mean, I haven't flown one before, so I'm not sure if it'll work out...

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: Or... What say we make one together? I've seen kids discussing the patterns they want to draw on theirs, so it might not be that difficult.

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: The two of us... Sure, let's give it a go!

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: I never knew kites came in so many styles...

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: Ah, don't worry, I didn't mean anything untoward by that.

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: Variety and novelty are a merchant's great loves, after all!

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: If we could use such stylizations in other products... Hmm, perhaps bring in some of those Fontainian machines we're importing... Yes, that could be a promising new market.

dialogues.speaker: Yiran
dialogues.text: Manager Kuan! Thanks for the kite you bought me! Now, let's go fly it!

dialogues.speaker: Manager Kuan
dialogues.text: Firstly, for the umpteenth time, just call me "Daddy."

dialogues.speaker: Manager Kuan
dialogues.text: Also, since I bought that kite, could you call me "Daddy"?

dialogues.speaker: Yiran
dialogues.text: Well, if you're "Daddy," why don't you take me kite-flying?

dialogues.speaker: Manager Kuan
dialogues.text: This... Well, Daddy's been working, so he doesn't know how to fly kites.

dialogues.speaker: Yiran
dialogues.text: In that case, maybe you should learn, Manager Kuan!

dialogues.speaker: Yiran
dialogues.text: You always tell me to study hard, Manager Kuan, so now it's your turn!

dialogues.speaker: Yiran
dialogues.text: You've gotta set a good example, right, Daddy?

dialogues.speaker: Granny Shan
dialogues.text: Happy Lantern Rite, youngster! See any toys you like?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about kites...

dialogues.speaker: Granny Shan
dialogues.text: Ah, so you're here to buy one, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Granny Shan
dialogues.text: There's lots of new designs for this year's Lantern Rite, and some of them have come equipped with devices that will let them fly more easily...

dialogues.speaker: Granny Shan
dialogues.text: As for me, I just have some traditional patterns, and all these newfangled items do rather confuse me. If you want to buy them, you might want to drop by Zhenyuan's stall.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Shan
dialogues.text: She's my niece, and she came to Liyue Harbor from Chenyu Vale this year to do business. Young people are full of energy, but they can be prone to mistakes, so please do take care of her.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: While the Millelith stands guard, evil shall never prevail.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: Have you flown any kites lately?

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: I saw many kids around these parts flying kites together...

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: I wonder if you could see them from atop the hills of Qingce Village...

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: *sigh* Liu... Your daddy misses you so much...

dialogues.speaker: Kun
dialogues.text: Hey, this is the big day! The annual Lantern Rite is finally here!

dialogues.speaker: Kun
dialogues.text: You see, seeing all of Liyue Harbor this lively is quite a rare sight.

dialogues.speaker: Kun
dialogues.text: If it wasn't for the fact that I need to stick to my post, I'd have bought a kite to fly already.

dialogues.speaker: Kun
dialogues.text: I mean, hearing them talk, you'd know that with that new mechanical propulsion thingamabob, any kite can fly with ease!

dialogues.speaker: Kun
dialogues.text: ...Hmm. Does that mean that I could fly a kite while working?

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: The kites follow the wind into the sky, across the heavens do they fly — save those that into lanterns crash, that burn to ashes in a flash.

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: Yes, yes...

dialogues.speaker: Andrei
dialogues.text: Why, hello there. How may I help you?

dialogues.speaker: Andrei
dialogues.text: If this is about work, please allow me to decline for now. This festive season is quite hard to come by after all. Feeling the sea breeze, watching the kites... It is all ever so pleasant...

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: New year, new horizons!

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: I mean, look, the kites this year have mechanical devices on them. Next thing you know, we'll be mounting compasses on our Xiao Lanterns!

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: That way, we can get them to send letters just like our pigeons.

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: Hmm? You think I'm kidding? Well, maybe I am!

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: Phew. Lantern Rite sure is a tiring time. Best get some rest...

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: But a strange anxiety seems to take me whenever I stop...

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: After all, Lady Yuheng has assigned us a new task for international cooperation, so I still can't rest...

dialogues.speaker: Yong'an
dialogues.text: Hello. I... you... cat... ATCHOO!

dialogues.speaker: Yong'an
dialogues.text: Sorry, sorry... But you know how this year's theme is kites, right? Well, people sometimes come to the docks to test theirs out...

dialogues.speaker: Yong'an
dialogues.text: And sometimes, they fail to fly, only to be snatched away by cats...

dialogues.speaker: Yong'an
dialogues.text: And then I need to help them retrieve those lost kites... the cats... ATCHOO!

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: Oh my, if it isn't my old acquaintance. Did you come all this way during Lantern Rite just to see me?

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: It's been a while, but you still look as lovely as ever.

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: Would you be interested in trying my new fragrance?

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: You could even daub some on the kite you're flying. That way, it'll carry far and wide.

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: I imagine such a kite would make a fine decoration in your home, too.

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: It's sure to leave a lasting impression.

dialogues.speaker: Zhenyuan
dialogues.text: Welcome! We've got all sorts of new kites here! Feel free to take a look!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll have a look at those kites.

dialogues.speaker: Zhenyuan
dialogues.text: Right over here, then. Take your time — I'll even give you a discount.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, about the kites here...

dialogues.speaker: Zhenyuan
dialogues.text: Oh? Are you wondering where I got them from? Well, they're all home-made by myself and my family!

dialogues.speaker: Zhenyuan
dialogues.text: Don't you worry, I've been learning this craft from my aunt Granny Shan since I was a kid. I've been in this line for over a decade now, so rest assured, my handiwork's fine as fine can be.

dialogues.speaker: Zhenyuan
dialogues.text: Ah, she was pleased as punch to hear that this year's theme was kites.

dialogues.speaker: Zhenyuan
dialogues.text: But she also told me in her letters of how she couldn't wrangle with those new Fontainian devices, so I came over to help her out.

dialogues.speaker: Zhenyuan
dialogues.text: You could say that kite-making's a family craft. If you like 'em, feel free to buy a few more!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the art of making kites...

dialogues.speaker: Zhenyuan
dialogues.text: Ah, guess I haven't told you all that much about my aunt, Granny Shan, have I?

dialogues.speaker: Zhenyuan
dialogues.text: Everyone in my family can at least sorta make kites, but she's the best at it by far. You could even call her love for making 'em an "obsession" of sorts.

dialogues.speaker: Zhenyuan
dialogues.text: How her eyes would sparkle when she taught me the traditional lantern patterns! I listened and studied hard... but I couldn't tell you if I'd ever catch up with her.

dialogues.speaker: Zhenyuan
dialogues.text: Hehe... Now, she might look old, but you should see the smile on her face when she's working with those kites!

dialogues.speaker: Zhenyuan
dialogues.text: If my kids are willing, I'd love to hand this craft down to them, too...

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: See you around.

dialogues.speaker: Zhenyuan
dialogues.text: See you! Have fun now, and have a Happy Lantern Rite!

dialogues.speaker: Xiaqing
dialogues.text: #{M#Dude}{F#Dudette} of legendary deeds, you're positively glowing. Looks like you're rarin' to go! Ready for a round of "Just Wushou Dance!"?

choices.text: Yes, I will have this dance.

response.speaker: Xiaqing
response.text: Rock on, have fun!

choices.text: About the props and venue for "Just Wushou Dance!"...

response.speaker: Xiaqing
response.text: Not bad, eh? All the mods were made by yours truly!

response.speaker: Xiaqing
response.text: I added several kinds of special talcum powder to the dance suit, and it all gets mixed together when you pull the rope! The mixture releases a bunch of gas, which helps the outfit suddenly stiffen, solid as a rock and proud as a lion!

response.speaker: Xiaqing
response.text: So no matter how much you jump and dance, or bump and prance, you won't get hurt none! Fun and safety, all in one!

response.speaker: Xiaqing
response.text: The technique's been used on ships for a long time now, y'know. Sailors use it to protect cargo! No matter how the waves toss around the boxes, the stuff inside won't get smashed to smithereens.

response.speaker: Xiaqing
response.text: Anyway, as for the venue, I rented it from the shop! A big ol' empty basement like that, just sitting there unused and wasted. Well, it's sure being put to good use now!

response.speaker: Xiaqing
response.text: The boss of this shop is pretty dope, too! Me promoting the Wushou Dance game helps bring in big business, so he didn't ask for much rent!

response.speaker: Xiaqing
response.text: Depending on how things go, maybe I'll even be able to get Gaming over to put on a real show here!

choices.text: Happy Lantern Rite! Don't forget to rest!

response.speaker: Xiaqing
response.text: No prob! Play hard, eat harder!

dialogues.speaker: Xiaqing
dialogues.text: Just bit more prep, and this event will be even doper!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (This person seems to be busy preparing an event, and doesn't have much time for idle banter...)

dialogues.speaker: Wenxun
dialogues.text: Round and fluffy, soft and bouncy... Now that's coming along nicely, almost done!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (She seems quite happy, concentrating so single-mindedly on prepping something... Best not to disturb her right now.)

dialogues.speaker: Juanshu
dialogues.text: I need to consider the route more carefully. we must maximize the number of people who will witness their passing radiance...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (She seems to be thinking about something very important. She hasn't even noticed our presence next to her.)
